name: Post Types Slider
author: Waqas Ahmed

sections.description:
Post Types Slider is a versatile plugin that enables you to create dynamic sliders for any WordPress post type, including custom post types and categories. Leveraging the power of the Slick Slider library, it ensures a responsive and touch-friendly experience on the frontend.

Features:

  • Create sliders for any post type or category.
  • Fully responsive design with touch and swipe support.
  • Easy integration using shortcodes.

Usage

To display a slider for a specific post type or category, use the following shortcode:
[posttysl_slider id=74]

Parameters:

  • id (required): The unique identifier of the slider you wish to display.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. For more information, please visit https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin Files:

    • Upload the post-types-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

  2. Activate the Plugin:

    • Navigate to the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress and activate the Post Types Slider plugin.

  3. Configure the Plugin:

    • Go to the plugin settings page to customize slider options as per your requirements.
sections.faq:
Q: Can I create multiple sliders with different settings?

A: Yes, you can create multiple sliders by using the shortcode with different parameters for each instance.

Q: Is the plugin compatible with custom post types?

A: Absolutely! The plugin is designed to work seamlessly with any custom post types registered in your WordPress installation.

Q: How can I customize the appearance of the slider?

A: The plugin provides various settings in the admin panel to customize the slider’s appearance and behavior. Additionally, you can override the default styles by adding custom CSS to your theme.
